title: Oscar and the Deadline
author: Sebastian Halloran
blurb: Sable Amberdale, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
